page_title: Graph Learning Research Trends and Tasks
summary: This page presents an overview of current research trends in graph learning, highlighting popular tasks, keyword rankings, and method usage over time. It includes visualizations of task distribution, top keywords from 2022-2023, and the frequency of various machine learning topics. The content emphasizes the growing interest in graph neural networks, transformers, and self-supervised learning approaches.

visuals.description: Pie chart showing the distribution of tasks in graph learning research, including node classification, graph learning, classification, action recognition, recommendation systems, skeleton based action recognition, graph classification, clustering, and graph attention.

Table showing the top-10 ranking of keywords between 2022 and 2023, including reinforcement learning, deep learning, representation learning, graph neural network, transformer, federate learning, self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, robustness, and generative model.
Line plot showing the usage over time of various graph learning methods including GCN, DCN, Graph Transformer, GAT, GraphSAGE, and MPNN.

Bar plot showing the 50 most appeared keywords in 2023, highlighting the frequency of terms like reinforcement learning, deep learning, representation learning, graph neural network, transformer, and others.

Horizontal bar chart showing the frequency or count of various machine learning research topics including knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, unsupervised learning, meta-learning, few-shot learning, domain adaptation, natural language processing, neural architecture search, attention, image classification, adversarial training, active learning, and deep neural network.
